articles.original_title: A Gigantic Stellar Eruption Spreads Planetary Material Into Space
articles.title_pt: Uma Gigante Erupção Estelar Espalha Material Planetário no Espaço
articles.excerpt: Asymptotic Giant Branch (AGB) stars spread heavy elements into space with their stellar winds. This material eventually forms more stars, and even rocky planets like ours. For a long time, astronomers thought this important mass-loss was driven by stellar winds. But new research shows how magnetic fields play an important role. A vast flare and magnetic loop of material from the AGB star Mira provides the evidence.
articles.summary: Estrelas do Ramo Assintótico das Gigantes espalham elementos pesados no espaço através de ventos estelares, ajudando a formar novos astros. Nova pesquisa demonstra que campos magnéticos desempenham um papel crucial nesse processo.
